h2plus.name: h2plus
h2plus.model: Reference-based elementary MO occupation scheme; ordinal levels only
h2plus.assumptions: Qualitative homonuclear MO ordering with Pauli/Hund filling, not a many-electron eigenproblem or calculated spatial orbital. Li through Ne diagrams omit filled 1s core pairs, which cancel in elementary bond order. B/C/N use π2p below σ2p; O/F/Ne reverse that order. HOMO means highest occupied spatial level; LUMO is the lowest entirely empty spatial orbital within this displayed basis. Open-shell singly occupied levels require spin-resolved frontier interpretation. He2 and Ne2 have zero elementary covalent bond order; this does not exclude weak dispersion-bound dimers.
